scope: Japan Place-specific research migration; jp-003 Hosooka sunset + jp-005 Otaru

research_sources.supports: Hosooka Viewpoint panorama of meandering Kushiro River, wetland and Akan mountains; sunset explicitly recommended

research_sources.authority: Kushiro Wetland Nature Restoration Project Data Center, Ministry of the Environment
research_sources.supports: Hosooka is on the east side of the wetland and provides sunset-lit wetland/river views

opportunities.name_zh: 細岡展望台釧路川濕原夕景
opportunities.best_time: 日落前後（景點當地時間／JST）

condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"細岡展望台 Camera Zone","target":"meandering Kushiro River + broad wetland + western sunset sky"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 合法展望區可達；日落時段有效；無明確封閉
condition_variants.required_conditions: 濕原與釧路川可辨；能見度足夠；低雲或降水未嚴重遮蔽夕照方向與主體
condition_variants.boosters: 中高雲提供夕彩；低霾；空氣透明度佳
condition_variants.penalties: 西方低雲完全封住夕照；濃霧；強降水；能見度明顯不足

viewpoints.note: Environment Ministry explicitly recommends the Hosooka sunset; coordinate cross-checked to mapped viewpoint.
viewpoints.name: 細岡展望台 Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: 細岡展望台／大觀望公共展望區；以觀景平台為 Camera Zone，不宣稱唯一腳架點。

research_sources.supports: representative photo spot at Asakusa Bridge Garden; 63 gas lamps; promenade gas lamps sunset-24:00; warehouse illumination sunset-22:30
Asakusa Bridge Garden is a representative Otaru Canal photography viewpoint

opportunities.name_zh: 小樽運河石造倉庫與運河景觀
opportunities.best_time: 白天至日落前（景點當地時間／JST）

condition_variants.variant_name: 淺草橋街園運河與石造倉庫
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"浅草橋街園 Camera Zone","subject":"curving canal + historic stone warehouses"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 合法公共步行區可達；可見光時段；無明確封閉
condition_variants.required_conditions: 運河與石造倉庫輪廓清楚；能見度足夠；低雲或降水未嚴重遮蔽主體
condition_variants.boosters: 低角度斜光；薄雲柔光；低霾；較少人潮
condition_variants.penalties: 濃霧；強降雨／降雪造成主體遮蔽；能見度明顯不足

viewpoints.note: Official tourism identifies Asakusa Bridge Garden as the representative Otaru Canal photography spot; coordinate cross-checked to mapped POI.
viewpoints.name: 浅草橋街園 Camera Zone
viewpoints.geometry_note: 淺草橋街園及橋頭公共拍攝區；代表 Camera Zone，不宣稱唯一腳架點。

opportunities.name_zh: 小樽運河暮色瓦斯燈與倉庫點燈
opportunities.best_time: 日落後至22:30（景點當地時間／JST；倉庫群點燈至22:30，散策路瓦斯燈至24:00）
opportunities.best_season: 全年；特殊活動另依官方公告

condition_variants.variant_name: 暮色運河＋瓦斯燈＋石造倉庫點燈
condition_variants.condition_geometry: {"camera_zone":"浅草橋街園 Camera Zone","subject":"canal + gas lamps + illuminated stone warehouses"}
condition_variants.hard_gates: 合法公共步行區可達；官方常態點燈時段；暮色／夜間時段有效
condition_variants.required_conditions: 運河與倉庫群可辨；能見度足夠；官方常態點燈時段成立
condition_variants.boosters: 藍調時段保留天空色階；低風可增加水面穩定感但完美倒影不是必要條件
condition_variants.penalties: 濃霧；強降水／降雪遮蔽；超出倉庫群點燈時段；臨時停止點燈

viewpoints.note: Same researched Camera Zone as daytime canal Opportunity.
